title: Neuronal Self-Adaptation Enhances Capacity and Robustness of Representation in Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2603.20687v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient, real-time edge computing, yet their performance is often constrained by the limited adaptability of conventional leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons. Existing LIF models struggle with restricted information capacity and susceptibility to noise, leading to degraded accuracy and compromised robustness. Inspired by the dynamic self-regulation of biological potassium channels, we propose the Potassium-regulated LIF (KvLIF) neuron model. KvLIF introduces an auxiliary conductance state that integrates membrane potential and spiking history to adaptively modulate neuronal excitability and reset dynamics. This design extends the dynamic response range of neurons to varying input intensities and effectively suppresses noise-induced spikes. translated_title: 神经元自适应增强脉冲神经网络表征的容量与鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）在节能、实时的边缘计算方面前景广阔，但其性能往往受限于传统漏积分-激发神经元有限的适应能力。现有LIF模型存在信息容量受限和易受噪声干扰的问题，导致准确率下降和鲁棒性受损。受生物钾通道动态自调节机制的启发，我们提出了钾调节LIF神经元模型。KvLIF引入了一个辅助电导状态，该状态整合膜电位和脉冲发放历史，以自适应地调节神经元的兴奋性和复位动力学。这一设计扩展了神经元对不同输入强度的动态响应范围，并有效抑制噪声诱发的脉冲。我们在静态图像和神经形态数据集上对KvLIF进行了广泛评估，结果表明其在分类准确率方面取得了一致的提升。
tldr: 受生物钾通道动态自调节机制启发，提出KvLIF神经元模型，通过辅助电导状态自适应调节神经元兴奋性与复位动力学，显著提升脉冲神经网络的信息容量和抗噪鲁棒性。
